text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph... A win's a win, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't a bad race. I was able to give it
my all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...But, it's not enough. I'm still tingling
with
passion...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...But, it's not enough. I'm still tingling
with
passion...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to meet people who fire me
up, enough
to satisfy this hunger.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's why... I just have to run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely. I won't be able to sleep
otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know. ...You've always got to
have the
last word, huh?
